name: admin_skill
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk skill — a reusable capability (Markdown docs, a package, or a private Git repo) that is assigned to personas.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the skill.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Skill type: 'Custom' (developed in-house) or 'External' (from a vendor). Defaults to 'Custom'.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How the skill is delivered: 'SkillMd' (Markdown), 'Package' (packaged artifact), or 'PrivateGitRepo' (private Git repository). Defaults to 'SkillMd'.

attributes.name: vendor
attributes.description: Vendor that provides the skill (for External skills).

attributes.name: skill_version
attributes.description: Version of the skill.

attributes.name: skill_md
attributes.description: Skill documentation in Markdown. Required for Custom skills with 'SkillMd' format; must be omitted for 'Package' and External skills.

attributes.name: package_path
attributes.description: Path to the skill package. Required for External skills. For Custom skills with 'Package' format, do not set this — save the skill first, then upload the package files (the path is managed by the backend).

attributes.name: git_repo
attributes.description: Private Git repository the skill is loaded from. Required for Custom skills with 'PrivateGitRepo' format.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Repository name.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: Organization or owner of the repository.

attributes.name: branch
attributes.description: Branch to load the skill from.

attributes.name: folder_path
attributes.description: Path within the repository to the skill folder.

attributes.name: scope_id
attributes.description: ID of the scope that provides Git access to the repository.

attributes.name: is_built_in
attributes.description: Whether this is a built-in skill. Built-in skills are system-provided and cannot be edited or deleted.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the skill.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the skill is active. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value metadata.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the skill was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the skill was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
